findings.evidence: All bound page, file, and anchor targets resolve, but links such as evidence.html#trace-requirements-REQ-001-accepted-answer_content.json land on plain list items containing only the reference label.
findings.problem: Trace links terminate at anchor-only catalog entries in evidence.html. The target entries repeat run-local references as text but do not open or render the exact frozen accepted, integration, or evidence content, so claim-to-evidence traceability is not actionable.
findings.required_change: Within the receipt-bound site, make each claim and metric trace actionable to exact frozen accepted, integration, and evidence content using safe direct local links or self-contained rendered evidence details; then rerun offline link and hash validation without changing analytical outcomes.
findings.target: Evidence trace links on the business-domain and data-quality audit pages

findings.evidence: No bound page links to ontology.html. The page displays Objects 7 and also says no ontology node summary was supplied; the candidate fixture has ontology_objects=[] and the assembler receipt reports ontology_counts.objects=0.
findings.problem: The receipt-bound ontology.html page is unreachable from every other bound HTML page and labels the aggregate ontology_items value as Objects 7 even though the rendered ontology object list and receipt object count are zero.
findings.required_change: Make the ontology view reachable from the site navigation and label counts according to their exact semantics, for example Total ontology items 7 rather than Objects 7, while preserving the visible no-node-summary limitation.
findings.target: Ontology page and global site navigation
